hero.role: Web & AI Development Manager · Satium Technologies
hero.thesis: I build and lead business software that runs in production: a tax-compliance SaaS platform for Mexico, Chile and Peru with fourteen applications, and products of my own such as Eventleta. I work with AI agents as part of the team.
hero.facts: 3 countries · 14 applications in production · migrations reconciled to the cent

about.title: Who I am
about.p1: I am a computer systems engineer from the Instituto Tecnológico de Tepic and I lead web and AI development at Satium Technologies. I joined in 2025 as an intern on the system we are now replacing; in March 2026 I took over as manager and since then I have built most of SATIUM: the API, the applications, the migration of client data and the production operation.
about.p2: The part I enjoy most is the hard stretch: taking a fifteen-year-old system, understanding why it does what it does, and rebuilding it without a single peso left unexplained. I work with AI agents as part of the team, with a method that makes them trustworthy.

method.d: A migration is done when every money screen matches the previous system, or the difference is explained to the cent.
Every application starts with a spec and a plan; the old system is the source of the rules, with file and line.

method.t: AI as a team, not a shortcut
method.d: I direct AI agents with specifications, tests and verification in the browser. Speed comes from there; trust comes from the method.
Deployment, alerting, backups, incidents and living documentation per module, so the next person can pick it up.

cases.title: Case studies
cases.lead: Eight fronts of a single product: SATIUM, the platform with which Satium Technologies replaces SIAREX, a Java system with fifteen years in production. Each case says what there was, what I decided and what came out.

platform.title: The platform
platform.lead: SATIUM is multi-company and multi-application: each client turns on the applications it uses. These are the ones I have built or migrated.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: What exists outside SATIUM: a product of my own in production and the first jobs where I learned to deliver.

path.title: Path
path.sport: I am a United States national team player in frontenis. High-performance sport taught me what I use every day: discipline, consistency and calm when the score gets tight.
